versions.changelog:
- Major update: Adds live n8n instance tooling, refines tool routing, and improves documentation structure.
- Expanded from 3 to 9 tools, including execution diagnostics and direct workflow management (list, create, activate).
- Tool names now use dot-notation (e.g., workflow.generate), replacing previous n8n_* naming.
- Clear separation of stateless tools vs. those requiring n8n API credentials.
- Added references directory for deeper context (expressions, AI agents, iteration, code node details, etc.), loaded only as needed.
- skill-card.md file removed to streamline documentation.

- Initial release of the n8n skill for natural language workflow authoring and linting.
- Generate n8n workflow JSON from plain English, including LangChain AI Agent setups.
- Scaffold custom TypeScript nodes using the n8n node API.
- Lint workflows for common issues: missing credentials, deprecated node types, broken connections, and more.
- Guides users on iteration, node conventions, and proper code node returns for reliable n8n automation.
- Requires the @automatelab/n8n-mcp server for MCP tool integration.
